# foundry_external_agent (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** requires `enable_preview` to include `"external_agents"`.

Looks up the latest version of a external agent by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "foundry" {
  account_name   = var.foundry_account_name
  project_name   = var.foundry_project_name
  enable_preview = ["external_agents"]
}

data "foundry_external_agent" "example" {
  name = "example-external-agent"
}

output "external_agent_otel_id" {
  value = data.foundry_external_agent.example.otel_agent_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the agent to look up.

### Read-Only

- `agent_guid` (String) Service-assigned unique identifier for the agent.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the agent instance identity.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the latest agent version was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the latest agent version.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the latest agent version.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the latest agent version.
- `otel_agent_id` (String) OpenTelemetry agent identifier.
- `principal_id` (String) Principal ID of the agent instance identity.
- `rai_config` (Attributes) Responsible AI policy applied to the agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rai_config))
- `status` (String) Provisioning status of the latest agent version.
- `version` (String) Latest agent version.

<a id="nestedatt--rai_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rai_config`

Read-Only:

- `rai_policy_name` (String) Name of the Responsible AI policy.
